rows.Title: This guy built a $30k MRR app in one day with Claude Code. Here's the tools he uses.
rows.Summary: Built a full app in one day with Claude Code.Jack runs Profit.ai, a Shopify profit analytics app that’s done $147K since launch in December and is at $30K MRR (plus ~$40K in services).He’s not technical. He built the original version by dumping a spreadsheet into Cursor as a CSV and iterating.Here’s what he runs the business on now:Claude Code on the $200/mo max plan for buildingCodex in Terminal (not the app) for extra coding muscleFramer for the marketing site (may swap to a Claude-built site)Instantly for outbound marketingGoogle Sheets for the ops layerSlack + Claude bot to pipe data wherever clients need it
